label: OPEN analyst reading of 'the mode of knowledge follows the mode of immateriality': having…
paraphrase: OPEN analyst reading of 'the mode of knowledge follows the mode of immateriality': having intellect (the primitive power HasIntellect, not an actual reception of forms) is closed upward along grades of immateriality: whatever is at least as immaterial as something with intellect has intellect. If abstract objects rank at least as high as an intellectual being, it gives them intellect; whoever denies that rejects this premise.
